learning_outcomes.text: The student/graduate understands fundamental grammatical concepts and structures of the English language, adapted to the study level (adjective/adverb distinctions, degrees of comparison, numerals, countable/uncountable nouns, pluralization, verb tenses).
The student/graduate understands general specialized vocabulary, relevant for conversational register, academic language, and specialized technical register.
The student/graduate identifies the linguistic and terminological particularities of different text types (technical document, personal document/correspondence, etc.).
The student/graduate identifies linguistic information sources and lexical resources (dictionaries, databases, online corpora) and integrates them into the learning process.
The student/graduate applies the grammatical rules and specific register norms of the English language.
The student/graduate operates with specialized vocabulary in written and oral expression in accordance with the communication context.
The student/graduate interprets and synthesizes information from texts and materials in English.
The student/graduate translates orally or in writing from English to Romanian and back in the broad specialized field of interest.
The student/graduate assumes autonomy in learning and continuous improvement of the English language.
The student/graduate participates in discussions and group projects in English, integrates into the work group, and applies effective teamwork and relationship techniques.
The student/graduate efficiently uses glossaries, dictionaries, and applications to better understand and translate from and into English.

The student/graduate carefully listens/reads the context/source text, analyzing and reviewing their own translations or those made by automatic translation machines, assuming the accuracy of the final message.

assessment_rules: The final evaluation result for a discipline is obtained by considering the scores and weights allocated to each activity within the discipline. Whole grades from 1 to 10 will be awarded. A grade of 5 certifies the acquisition of the minimum learning outcomes for a discipline and the granting of its study credits.
